Title: OpenAI Is the Sole Investor in Its Latest Venture Fund
description: OpenAI is launching a second startup fund—this time pulling from its own balance sheet.  An affiliate of the ChatGPT maker filed paperwork with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday indicating it has raised a $400 million sophomore fund.  OpenAI launched its first startup fund, a $175 million haul, in 2021.

Title: Nvidia doubles revenue, forecasts even more AI spending
description: AI juggernaut Nvidia on Wednesday reported quarterly revenue of $96.2 billion, more than double from a year earlier, as the world's most valuable company beat Wall Street expectations and forecast even stronger sales ahead.Nvidia told investors to expect about $108 billion in revenue in the current quarter, well ahead of Wall Street forecasts and a signal that the company sees no near-term slowdown in AI spending.
